chapters.label: THE COURSE
chapters.title: Thirteen ziplines, ten suspended bridges
chapters.body: The experience is straightforward: arrive at Fandee Island, get fitted with the provided safety equipment and follow a coach through a forest aerial course made up of thirteen ziplines and ten monkey bridges. Visit Tad Lo rates it moderate and lists staff instructions as required, so this is not an unguided playground. The attraction is the course itself — a compact dose of height and movement that fits easily into a Tad Lo day without needing a separate excursion.

note.label: SAFETY FIRST
note.text: Equipment and coaching are included. Listen to the briefing, follow staff instructions and do not bypass the course rules.
